evals.name: create-when-absent
evals.prompt: Capture https://example.com/app login and dashboard with Playwright and build a runnable prototype. There is no prototype/ folder yet. Workspace is the project root.
evals.expected_output: Boot asks URL/scope; detects missing prototype/ and states create mode; uses Playwright MCP; writes AS-IS under docs/; scaffolds and implements under prototype/ only (no v1/ folder); loads ns-frontend-design; later quality + appearance consolidator; may offer ns-proto-visual-guide.

evals.name: evolve-when-present
evals.prompt: Our prototype/ already exists. Add the settings page from https://staging.example.com/settings — evolve the current prototype, do not start a new version folder.
evals.expected_output: States evolve-in-place; does not scaffold vN/prototype/; updates docs AS-IS and prototype/ in place; reminds optionally to git commit; does not ask for version folder name.

evals.name: visual-md-near-miss
evals.prompt: I only need a descrição normativa / *-visual.md for the side panel shell from existing prototype components. Do not rebuild the prototype.
evals.expected_output: Redirects to ns-proto-visual-guide; does not run full capture/build orchestration as primary path.
